name: Garam Masala
siboNotes: Traditional garam masala is well-tolerated in typical cooking amounts. Avoid pre-made blends that may contain onion or garlic powder.
preparationTips: Use authentic blends with whole spices (cumin, coriander, cardamom, cinnamon, cloves)
Make your own blend to ensure no garlic or onion powder is added
Store in airtight container to maintain potency and freshness
Toast whole spices lightly before grinding for enhanced flavor
nutritionalHighlights: Rich in antioxidants from diverse spices
Good source of manganese and iron
May support digestive health in small amounts
